title: No part of the system holds a consciousness essence

statements.text: Asking whether consciousness resides in the attended process, the model or higher cognition misreads the framework. It explains the behavior of an agent that says it is conscious without positing a consciousness stuff in any part.

sources.quote: Illusionism explains the behavior of the system without postulating the existence of a consciousness stuff that emerges from or resides in any part of the system.
